name: Oneechan ga "Nandemo Shite" Agechau
original_name: お姉ちゃんが「なんでもして」あげちゃう
source:
Summer vacation.
While his parents are gone, his sexy neighbors come to housesit and babysit.
His schedule in their hands: dinner, bathtime, bedtime.
From the moment he wakes up to the moment he falls asleep,
the onesans are duty-bound to take good care of him. Who knows what'll happen!

"Why... why is this happening to me!?"

You wake up to an empty house and a note on the table. It reads:

"Dear Son,
Sorry for the sudden news, while your mom and I are gone we've asked your old friends next door Saki-chan and Ai-chan to take care of you!
Good chance to get to know those cuties better. Don't waste it!
Love, Dad" 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE188070.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
暑假。
当他的父母去世时，他性感的邻居来照看房子和保姆。
他的日程安排掌握在他们手中：晚餐、洗澡、睡觉。
从他醒来的那一刻起，到他入睡的那一刻，
姐姐们有责任照顾好他。谁知道会发生什么！

“为什么……为什么这种事会发生在我身上！？”

你醒来时看到一间空房子，桌子上有一张纸条。上面写着：

“亲爱的儿子，
很抱歉突然传来这个消息，我和你妈妈不在的时候，就拜托了你隔壁的老朋友小咲和爱酱来照顾你了！
更好地了解这些小可爱们的好机会。别浪费了！
爱，爸爸”
